repos.name: claude-recall
repos.description: Back up your Claude conversations when Anthropic's export doesn't work.  This tool connects to your logged-in Chrome, walks through your conversations, and saves everything — messages, thinking blocks, metadata — to a local SQLite database. Two commands: one to extract, one to backfill full thinking block content.

repos.name: doc-md
repos.description: A local-first markdown knowledge management app — an Obsidian alternative built with Tauri 2 (Rust) and Svelte 5.  Notes are stored as plain markdown files on disk. No proprietary formats, no cloud lock-in. Targets Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android from a single codebase.

repos.name: gitmarks
repos.description: Serverless cross-browser bookmark sync. Your bookmarks live as a JSON file in your own private GitHub repo; the extensions talk directly to the GitHub Contents API. No server, no backend.

repos.name: server-start
repos.description: Windows system tray app for managing dev servers   across multiple projects

repos.name: window-snap
repos.description: Custom window arrangement system tray app for Windows 11. Snap windows into predefined layouts with hotkeys.
